title: Designers Need to Start Using Coding Agents
description:
It’s a lot easier than it sounds to start using coding agents like Codex.

You can prompt a rough idea, give it a design direction, and have a working prototype in less than 10 minutes.

That’s where the real work begins.

Because the real skill isn’t generating the app.

It’s knowing what to change in the UX, the layout, the features, and the details. The little decisions that make something actually useful and give it a reason to exist.

This is why I think the best way to learn design right now is to learn how to build, test, and refine your own ideas.

#uxdesign #codex #claudecode #productdesign
